CustomField.description: Calcula la cantidad de días hábiles transcurridos (No descuenta feriados)
CustomField.formula:
if ( (ISPICKVAL(StageName,"Cerrada Ganada") || ISPICKVAL(StageName,"Cerrada Perdida")),Null,
(FLOOR((TODAY() - DATEVALUE( CreatedDate )) / 7) * 5) /* compute the number of complete workweeks */ + WEEKDAY(TODAY()) /* add enddate's weekday */ - WEEKDAY(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate )) /* subtract startdate's weekday */ + MIN(MAX(WEEKDAY(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate )) - WEEKDAY(TODAY()), 0), 1) * 5 /* add 5 if startdate is later in week than enddate */ + FLOOR(WEEKDAY(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate )) / 7) /* add 1 if startdate is a Saturday */ - FLOOR(WEEKDAY(TODAY()) / 7) )
CustomField.label: Días Transcurridos
